name: deathrattle_taunt_divergence
description: boss-ai A10. The player's 1/1 Taunt must die first; its Deathrattle deals 1 damage to a random friendly minion. On the bomb, the bomb's Deathrattle summons a 0/9 Taunt; on the 1/5, nothing. Two 3/2s then go face for 6 against a player at 6. The search draws from the sim fork, the sandbox from its rng_match copy: expect.ai_seed makes the fork spare the bomb and expect.live_offset makes the sandbox hit it, so the plan's second step is no longer legal. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
